subject: history_social
passage: Angkor Wat, in northwestern Cambodia, was built in the early twelfth century under the Khmer king Suryavarman II. The temple, which was first dedicated to the Hindu god Vishnu and later became a Buddhist ______ is surrounded by a moat about 190 meters wide. Its five central towers represent the peaks of Mount Meru, the home of the gods in Hindu and Buddhist tradition.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The clause "which was first dedicated … and later became a Buddhist shrine" is extra information about the temple. It opens with a comma after "The temple," so it must close with a comma before the verb "is surrounded."
explanation.A: Incorrect. A colon must follow a complete independent clause; it can't separate a subject from its verb.
explanation.B: Correct. The comma closes the nonessential "which" clause, so the subject "The temple" connects to its verb "is surrounded."
explanation.C: Incorrect. A semicolon can't separate the subject "The temple" from its verb "is surrounded."
explanation.D: Incorrect. Without a closing comma, the "which" clause runs straight into the main verb "is surrounded."
